name: ballerinax/java.jms
description: Java Message Service (JMS) is a standard API for sending messages between two or more clients. It provides a common way for programs to create, send, receive, and read distributed enterprise messages. The JMS connector enables seamless integration with JMS providers, supporting various messaging patterns such as publish-subscribe and point-to-point.

typeDefs.name: SESSION_TRANSACTED
typeDefs.description:
Indicates that the session will use a local transaction which may subsequently 
be committed or rolled back by calling the session's `commit` or `rollback` methods.

typeDefs.name: AUTO_ACKNOWLEDGE
typeDefs.description:
Indicates that the session automatically acknowledges a client's receipt of a message 
either when the session has successfully returned from a call to `receive` or when 
the message listener the session has called to process the message successfully returns.

typeDefs.name: CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE
typeDefs.description:
Indicates that the client acknowledges a consumed message by calling the 
MessageConsumer's or Caller's `acknowledge` method. Acknowledging a consumed message 
acknowledges all messages that the session has consumed.

typeDefs.name: DUPS_OK_ACKNOWLEDGE
typeDefs.description:
Indicates that the session to lazily acknowledge the delivery of messages. 
This is likely to result in the delivery of some duplicate messages if the JMS provider fails, 
so it should only be used by consumers that can tolerate duplicate messages. 
Use of this mode can reduce session overhead by minimizing the work the session does to prevent duplicates.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initialize and starts a JMS connection.
```ballerina
jms:Connection connection = check new (
  initialContextFactory = "org.apache.activemq.jndi.ActiveMQInitialContextFactory",
  providerUrl = "tcp://localhost:61616"
);
```

functions.name: createSession
functions.description:
Create a Session object, specifying transacted and acknowledgeMode.
```ballerina
jms:Session session = check connection->createSession();
```

parameters.name: ackMode
parameters.description: Configuration indicating how messages received by the session will be acknowledged

return.description: Returns the Session or an error if it fails.

functions.name: 'start
functions.description:
Starts (or restarts) a connection's delivery of incoming messages.
A call to start on a connection that has already been started is ignored.
```ballerina
check connection->'start();
```

functions.name: stop
functions.description:
Temporarily stops a connection's delivery of incoming messages.
Delivery can be restarted using the connection's start method.
```ballerina
check connection->stop();
```

return.description: A `jms:Error` if threre is an error while stopping the connection

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the connection.
```ballerina
check connection->close();
```

return.description: A `jms:Error` if threre is an error while closing the connection

clients.name: MessageConsumer
clients.description: JMS Message Consumer client object to receive messages from both queues and topics.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Message consumer type

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Name of the JMS destination

parameters.name: messageSelector
parameters.description:
only messages with properties matching the message selector expression are added to the durable subscription. 
An empty string indicates that there is no message selector for the durable subscription.

parameters.name: noLocal
parameters.description:
if true then any messages published to the topic using this session's connection, or any other connection 
with the same client identifier, will not be added to the durable subscription.

parameters.name: subscriberName
parameters.description: the name used to identify the subscription

functions.name: receive
functions.description:
Receives the next message that arrives within the specified timeout interval.
```ballerina
jms:Message? message = check consumer->receive(10000);
```

parameters.name: timeoutMillis
parameters.description: Message receive timeout

return.description:
A `jms:JmsMessage` if there is a new message, `()` if there is no any new message, 
or else a `jsm:Error` if there is an error in the execution

functions.name: receiveNoWait
functions.description:
Receives the next message if one is immediately available.
```ballerina
jms:Message? message = check consumer->receiveNoWait();
```

return.description:
A `jms:JmsMessage` if there is a new message, `()` if there is no any new message, 
or else a `jsm:Error` if there is an error in the execution

functions.name: acknowledge
functions.description:
Mark a JMS message as received.
```ballerina
check consumer->acknowledge(message);
```

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: JMS message record

return.description: A `jms:Error` if there is an error in the execution or else `()`

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the message consumer.
```ballerina
check consumer->close();
```

return.description: A `jms:Error` if there is an error or else `()`

functions.name: unsubscribe
functions.description:
Unsubscribe a durable subscription that has been created by this session.
It is erroneous for a client to delete a durable subscription while there is an active (not closed) consumer
for the subscription, or while a consumed message being part of a pending transaction or has not been
acknowledged in the session.
```ballerina
check session->unsubscribe("subscription-1");
```

parameters.name: subscriptionId
parameters.description: The name, which is used to identify the subscription

return.description: A `jms:Error` if there is an error or else `()`
